vetSays.line: 🛡️ Paisley, Michael and Vy met them at the door — 3 put down. Paisley, Michael, Vy are hurt.
🛡️ Vy, Abril, Maya and Elif met them at the door — 4 put down. Vy, Abril, Maya, Elif are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Vy — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Vy chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Glasswing Darter (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Michael. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Glasswing Darter shifts, seeking a clear lane.
Michael strikes the Pack-leader Glasswing Darter.
The Pack-leader Glasswing Darter falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Glasswing Darter!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Glasswing Darter, Glasswing Darter (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader Glasswing Darter, Glasswing Darter (packmate).

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Abril, Elif, Thabo and Boris met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Abril, Elif, Thabo, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vy Crawford, 19 — a paramedic. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Berserker Rage, Cold-Blooded, Green Thumb, Literally, Lucky Rock.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Vasyl was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Riley taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Fireside lesson: Riley passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
